findings.title: Contributing commands are invalid (`uv ruff check`, `uv format`)
findings.description: The setup steps say `uv ruff check .` and `uv format .`. Neither is a valid uv subcommand. The correct forms are `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .` (or `uv format` only on very recent uv). A contributor following these steps gets errors.
findings.suggestion: Use `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format .`.

findings.title: Wrong pre-commit command `uv run precommit install`
findings.description: The tool is named `pre-commit`, not `precommit`. The documented command fails.
findings.suggestion: Change to `uv run pre-commit install`.

findings.title: Same invalid uv/ruff and precommit commands duplicated in docs copy
findings.description: docs/contributing.md repeats `uv ruff check .`, `uv format .` and `uv run precommit install`, all of which fail.
findings.suggestion: Fix the commands and de-duplicate the file, e.g. via an include or symlink.

findings.title: Empty mkdocs link
findings.description: `[mkdocs]()` is a link with an empty target and renders as a broken link.
findings.suggestion: Use `[mkdocs](https://www.mkdocs.org/)`.

findings.title: Empty mkdocs link
findings.description: `[mkdocs]()` is a link with an empty target.
findings.suggestion: Use `[mkdocs](https://www.mkdocs.org/)`.

findings.title: Test checks builtin `format` instead of `output_format`
findings.description: `if format is not None:` tests the builtin `format`, which is always non-None. When `output_format` is None (the first parametrized case), `args.extend(["--format", None])` gets passed. The None case is never truly exercised.
findings.suggestion: Use `if output_format is not None:`.

findings.title: Docstrings in DotEnv.get and load_dotenv are inaccurate or empty
findings.description: `DotEnv.get` has an empty docstring (`""" """`). The `load_dotenv` docstring omits the `interpolate` parameter. It also says `verbose` outputs a warning, but the code uses logger.info. The `dotenv_values` docstring omits `interpolate` too.
findings.suggestion: Document `interpolate`, fix the `verbose` description, and fill in the `get` docstring.

findings.title: DotEnv.dict cache ignores empty results
findings.description: `if self._dict:` is falsy for an empty dict, so an empty result is re-parsed on every call. `set_as_environment_variables` calls `self.dict()` twice. For a stream this can yield an empty result on the second call because the stream is already consumed. Use `is not None` for the cache check.
findings.suggestion: Use `if self._dict is not None:`.

findings.title: Redundant exception tuple
findings.description: `except (FileNotFoundError, OSError)` is redundant because FileNotFoundError is a subclass of OSError.
findings.suggestion: Use `except OSError`.

findings.title: Temp file created with default permissions, then chmod after write (secrets window)
findings.description: NamedTemporaryFile is created with 0600 by default, so the temp file itself is safe. But when the original file is absent or not a regular file, the fallback mode is whatever the default gives. The behavior is undocumented in code and only described in the changelog. `os.replace` on a symlinked path replaces the link, which is intended.
findings.suggestion: Document the permission behavior in the docstring.

findings.title: get_cli_string builds a shell string without escaping
findings.description: `get_cli_string` interpolates path, key and value into a command string. Only values containing spaces get quoted, and quotes are not escaped. If the result is executed via a shell, this allows command injection through untrusted input.
findings.suggestion: Use `shlex.quote` for each argument and document that the output is shell-sensitive.

findings.title: Typo and grammar error in breaking-change note
findings.description: 'Is the file needed to be created or wasn't a regular file' should read 'If the file needed to be created or wasn't a regular file'.
findings.suggestion: Fix the wording.

findings.title: Placeholder Unreleased entry and unused link references
findings.description: The Unreleased section contains only '- ...'. Link references such as [@burnout-projects], [@cpackham-atlnz] and [#359] are defined but never used. There is no [0.10.3]-style compare link for the older unreleased-tagged sections.
findings.suggestion: Remove the placeholder and unused link definitions.

findings.title: Duplicated files (changelog, contributing, index) instead of includes
findings.description: docs/changelog.md, docs/index.md and docs/contributing.md are verbatim copies of the root files. requirements-docs.txt lists mkdocs-include-markdown-plugin, but mkdocs.yml does not enable it. The copies can drift apart.
findings.suggestion: Use symlinks or the include-markdown plugin, and add the plugin to mkdocs.yml or remove it from requirements.

findings.title: Unpinned dev dependencies and stale bumpversion/wheel
findings.description: All dev requirements are unpinned. `bumpversion` is unmaintained, and version.py no longer has a bumpversion config in the shown files. `wheel` is unnecessary with PEP 517 builds. `mkdocs-include-markdown-plugin` in requirements-docs.txt is unused by mkdocs.yml.
findings.suggestion: Remove bumpversion and wheel, pin versions or use a lock file, and drop the unused docs plugin.

findings.title: click minimum version too permissive
findings.description: `click>=5.0` is declared, but the code uses features (`click.Choice`, `version_option(version=...)`, `UNPROCESSED`, `ctx.args`) that need much newer click. Click 5.0 is very old.
findings.suggestion: Raise the minimum to a tested version, e.g. `click>=8.0`.

findings.title: Popen imported conditionally; typing uses tuple[...] alongside typing.List/Dict
findings.description: The module mixes `typing.List`/`Dict` with builtin `tuple[str, ...]`. It also evaluates `enumerate_env()` at import time for the default `--file`, so the cwd is frozen at import.
findings.suggestion: Use consistent typing style and compute the default lazily.

findings.title: Tests use os.chdir without restoring
findings.description: test_find_dotenv_* and test_load_dotenv_in_current_dir call `os.chdir` directly, not `monkeypatch.chdir`. This leaks cwd state between tests and risks flakiness.
findings.suggestion: Use `monkeypatch.chdir`.

findings.title: Debug print in test helper
findings.description: `print(f"setup_zipfile: ...")` is left in the test helper.
findings.suggestion: Remove the print.

findings.title: `get` treats empty-string values as missing
findings.description: `if stored_value:` exits 1 for an empty-string value, which is not distinguished from an absent key. There is no test for it.
findings.suggestion: Use `is not None` if empty values should be printed, and add a test.
